candidates.description: This vector represents religious faiths, institutions, figures, and practices associated with major world religions, particularly Christianity.
This vector represents possessive determiners and pronouns indicating ownership or association.
This vector represents events, practices, and expressions associated with communal celebrations, rituals, and festive gatherings.
This vector represents the concept of romantic love, affection, and emotional or physical intimacy.
This vector represents the concept of cultural heritage, customs, and historical traditions.
This vector represents concepts related to warnings, cautions, and reminders.
This vector represents verbs of internal mental states, cognitive processes, and personal intentions.
This vector represents distinct periods or spans of time in history and culture.
This feature activates for political, economic, and ideological terminology relating to nations, power structures, and global systems.
These tokens represent adverbs and adverbial modifiers of frequency, probability, and time.
